styles.name: Aperture
styles.note: Openings and counterforms — what the dispenser leaves behind.

styles.name: Band
styles.note: Horizontal bands — label blocks, the tray, the wordmark rule.

styles.name: Petal
styles.note: Radial repetition — the fragrance note, the bloom.

styles.name: Arc
styles.note: Open arcs — the refill loop, left deliberately incomplete.

styles.name: Knot
styles.note: One continuous line that crosses itself.

styles.name: Frill
styles.note: A ruffled bloom — many narrow petals, wavy edged, drawn as outlines.

styles.name: Tendril
styles.note: Looping stems and ribbon, terminating in beads.

styles.name: Spotted
styles.note: A broad flared petal, spotted — the trumpet flower.

styles.name: Branch
styles.note: Tree silhouettes with real habit — spreading, columnar, conical, weeping, vase.

styles.name: Leaf, line
styles.note: A blade and its veining, outline only.

styles.name: Thread
styles.note: Screw threads in profile — the geometry of every lid you've drawn.

styles.name: Fitting
styles.note: Bracket, flange, mounting plate — hairline outline, drilled.

styles.name: Glyph
styles.note: One dominant gesture, shaped negative space, one contour.

styles.name: Blot
styles.note: Bilateral inkblot — lobes mirrored, waist pinched.

styles.name: Creature
styles.note: Fluid sweeping ribbons with lens counters.

styles.name: Lens
styles.note: An almond drawn in open strokes, crossed by a tail.

styles.name: Slab
styles.note: Orthogonal slabs and brackets — modular, mirrored.

styles.name: Idol
styles.note: An organic mass with islands, standing on blocky legs.

styles.name: Speckle
styles.note: A body carrying many oval counters.

styles.name: Figure
styles.note: A person mid-stride. Asymmetric — the pose is the content.

styles.name: Brush
styles.note: Gestural strokes, thick in the middle and spent at the ends.

styles.name: Seal
styles.note: Bronze-script weight — orthogonal bars, enclosures, counters.

styles.name: Counter
styles.note: A solid mass with a geometric hole; the counterform carries it.

styles.name: Totem
styles.note: A body, limbs, a head — mirrored, and carved rather than plotted.

styles.name: Eye
styles.note: Nested rings with uneven weight. The oldest mark there is.

styles.name: Strider
styles.note: A lunging figure, with loose glyph fragments.

styles.name: Cross-seal
styles.note: Bronze-script cross in a blocky frame.

styles.name: Slit-X
styles.note: A slitted crest above a thick tapered X.

styles.name: Crescent
styles.note: One bold swoosh closing on a pointed star.

styles.name: Dancer
styles.note: A figure inside a ruled square.

styles.name: Sweep
styles.note: A striding figure written in brush sweeps.

styles.name: Block
styles.note: A cross with a rectangular void and two legs.

styles.name: Blot
styles.note: Bilateral butterfly, bulbous lobes, pinched waist.

styles.name: Whale
styles.note: Fluid curves carrying lens counters.

styles.name: Winged
styles.note: A figure with a wing and a lens through the body.

styles.name: Eye
styles.note: An almond in open strokes, crossed by a tail.

styles.name: Brackets
styles.note: Two mirrored E-forms with satellites beneath.

styles.name: Ring-cross
styles.note: An orthogonal cross over a thin ellipse.

styles.name: Idol
styles.note: A blobby mass with islands on blocky legs.

styles.name: Carrier
styles.note: A walking figure holding a slotted block.

styles.name: Spotted
styles.note: A body carrying many oval counters.
